reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel/note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution profile and returned-note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source-note enlargement has two compact upper gray-mark rows and no separate lower-left third mark. The returned native pixels add a third lower-left gray dash below the two main rows. Remove that invented mark and restore only the source-scale two-row upper footprint, leaving the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: The dark olive peaked cap retains gold crown piping, a gold wreath-like front insignia and the source's bright pale reflection on the dark visor. Short dark temple/nape hair and a dark profile-side eyebrow remain. The distinctive near-profile still faces and gazes viewer left, with one firm closed mouth and no spectacles or added beard. Three-quarter shoulders, chest-up crop, strong visor shadow and warm cheek light remain. The uniform retains red-and-gold collar details, a prominent gold viewer-left shoulder board, and one small pale/red neck ribbon with a silver-toned detail partly beside the note. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete tilted dark frame, darker opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring; the added note dash is the separate rejection reason above.
entries.visible_limitations: The narrow upper-lip detail cannot be confidently separated from shadow, and exact cap/neck insignia are too small to transcribe; neither is an additional rejection reason. Note glyphs are not readable text, but the source clearly lacks the returned separate third lower-left dash.
